newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Notionnel can hit 130.76 before retreat.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Notionnel can hit 130.76 before retreat.

text.p: June notionnel futures on MATIF can extend the upmove to 130.76 but that level should prove insurmountable for now, technical analysts said.
They added a correction of the June rally was now in store.

"The big resistance starts at 130.50 and extends up to 130.76," said David Sneddon, technical analyst at Credit Suisse First Boston in London. "We'll look for that level to cap the market for a correction lower. It may not start today if T-bonds can hold up."
June notionnel futures were quoted at 130.26, up 22 basis points from Thursday's settelment.
Sneddon said resistance at 130.50 came from the down trendline drawn off the February and May highs while 130.76 represented the high for May on May 16.
Richard Adcock, manager of technical research at HSBC Futures in London, also expected the contract to push ahead to the 130.76 level in the short term.

"Yesterday morning saw confirmation of the break up through the recent highs, leaving the consolidation of the last few days looking like a bullish flag pattern, projecting prices higher over the next few days," he said in a research note.
But Sneddon did not expect the extension to last long and saw notionnel receding to initial support at 130.16.
He said support there came from old highs and lows, with the high from June 12 coming in at 130.08. It was also a target on the way up.
Price support would then arrive at 129.58,56 and a stronger buffer at 129.44 from Fibonacci support.
September Pibor were quoted at 96.53, up four basis points in the session. Earlier, they were rebuffed at 96.55 strong resistance from a down trendline drawn off this year's peaks.
A break through there would set up a move to the 96.61 high on May 14, longer term.
